goal.headline:
Every goal starts
with a number
goal.sub: Tell Piggy what you're saving for. We'll turn it into a month-by-month plan you can actually keep.

noBank.headline:
No bank login.
Ever.
noBank.sub: Piggy never connects to your accounts. There's nothing to link, and nothing for anyone to steal.

coach.headline:
A coach
in your pocket
coach.sub: Streaks, missions, and an AI coach that knows your plan — so month three feels as good as day one.

contribution.monthlyHeadline:
How much can you
set aside each month?
contribution.monthlySub: We'll work out when you'll hit your goal.
contribution.reachGoalBy: At {{symbol}}{{amount}}/month you'll reach your goal by
contribution.cappedWarning: At this rate it'll take over 10 years. Try raising your monthly amount or lowering your goal.
contribution.incomeWarning: That's a big chunk of your income. Make sure it's comfortable — you can always adjust later.
contribution.switchToDeadline: I have a fixed deadline instead
contribution.deadlineHeadline:
When do you want
to achieve this?
contribution.deadlineSub: Pick the date — we'll work out your monthly contribution.
contribution.deadlineIncomeWarning: This date requires setting aside a large share of your income. We can adjust this later!

common.resumeBanner: Welcome back, {{firstName}} — picking up where you left off.
common.resumeBannerNoName: Picking up where you left off.

name.headline:
Welcome to Piggy!
What should we call you?
name.errorEmpty: Hey, we'd love to know your name! 😊

ageGate.blockedBody: We're not able to create an account for you based on the date of birth you confirmed. This app isn't available to users under 18.
ageGate.headline:
When were you born,
{{firstName}}?
ageGate.sub: Piggy is only available to users 18 and older, so we need to confirm your age before we go any further.
ageGate.privacyNote: This is a legal age requirement, not profiling. We use your date of birth to confirm you're 18 — it's never used to target you or shared with anyone.

localization.headline:
Where are you based,
{{firstName}}?
localization.sub: We'll use this to format currency and set helpful defaults.

goal.headline: What are we saving for?
goal.sub: Pick a goal or type your own below.
goal.errorEmpty: Tell us what you're saving for! 🎯

targetAmount.headline:
How much do you need
for your {{goalName}}?
targetAmount.sub: Don't worry, you can always adjust this later.
targetAmount.errorEmpty: Please enter an amount greater than 0 💸

income.headline:
To build your roadmap,
what is your average
monthly income?
income.sub: We use this only to calculate how much you need to set aside. Your data is encrypted and completely private.
income.skip: I'd rather not say right now

blueprint.headline: Let's make this official!
blueprint.exceedsIncomeWarning: This plan sets aside more than your income each month. We can adjust it anytime!
blueprint.incomeSkippedNote: Providing your income on the dashboard will unlock deep affordability insights tailored to your situation.
blueprint.monthsAway_one: You're only {{count}} month away from your dream. Let's make it happen.
blueprint.monthsAway_other: You're only {{count}} months away from your dream. Let's make it happen.

pushPermission.headline:
Want a nudge when
it counts, {{firstName}}?
pushPermission.sub: Saving {{amount}} a month is easy to plan and easy to forget. A quick reminder is what keeps a streak alive.
pushPermission.streakBody: A heads-up when today's set-aside is still outstanding.
pushPermission.milestoneBody: We'll tell you the moment your {{goalName}} hits 25%, 50%, 75%.
pushPermission.milestoneBodyFallback: We'll tell you the moment your goal hits 25%, 50%, 75%.
pushPermission.weeklyBody: One calm summary of how the week went. No spam, ever.
pushPermission.footerNote: You can change any of this later in Settings.

account.headline: Your Piggy Plan is ready!
account.subEmailConfirmed: Your email is confirmed — we just need to finish building your plan for your {{goalName}}.
account.subOtpSent: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed to {{email}} to finish setting up your account.
account.subInitial: Enter your email — we'll send a sign-in code to lock in your plan for your {{goalName}} by {{date}}.
account.emailError: Please enter a valid email address 📧
account.codeLabel: Sign-in code (this is not your app PIN)
account.requestCodeError: Oops! We couldn't send your code. Please check your connection and try again.
account.otpEnterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your email.
account.sessionSecretError: Signed in, but we could not secure the session. Request a new code and try again.
account.codeIncorrect: That code is incorrect or expired. Request a new code and try again.
account.provisionError: We verified your email but couldn't finish setting up your account. Your code is still good — tap Retry.

legal.reassuranceTitle: We're asking for your email. Not your bank.
legal.reassuranceBody: Piggy never connects to your accounts — there's nothing to link, and nothing for anyone to steal. Your plan is encrypted and private.
legal.acceptTerms: By creating an account you accept our terms
